items.title: Article: Governed Autonomous Intelligence for Mission-Critical Utility
items.summary: The article describes an architecture for agentic AI in regulated utility operations. Agents reason and propose actions, but a deterministic policy gate and a governed tool gateway control execution, with human approval where required. It covers an AWS reference implementation, grounding in runbooks, governed prediction, outcome validation, audit evidence, and phased autonomy. By Purnang Borah

By Daniel Dominguez

items.title: Qwik 2.0 RC: Replaces HTML Comment Markers for Faster Reactivity and Out-of-Order Streaming
items.summary: Qwik 2.0 Release Candidate, published on 1 October 2026, replaces v1's HTML comment markers with two script blocks that hold state and virtual node data. It adds experimental out-of-order streaming, async useComputed$, and cacheable route loaders. Qwik's benchmarks show v2 at 1.23x vanilla JavaScript, versus 2.59x for v1. A migration command is provided. By Daniel Curtis

items.title: Microsoft Releases .NET 11: C# 15 Union Types, Native AOT CLI Host, and CoreCLR by Default in MAUI
items.summary: Microsoft has released .NET 11, a Standard Term Support release with two years of support. It ships C# 15 with union types and closed hierarchies, a Native AOT CLI host, a preview of Runtime Async, Zstandard compression, asynchronous validation and OpenAPI 3.2 in ASP.NET Core, CoreCLR as the default runtime in .NET MAUI, and EF Core 11 with experimental vector search. By Almir Vuk
